about: Fast-moving sources this course depends on. 'version' is what the course was last checked against ('compare': how many leading version parts count as a change) and 'verified' is the date of that check. scripts/check_course.py fails when a file cites a tracked fact with another value (cite_patterns); scripts/check_freshness.py (weekly workflow) reports when upstream moves past 'version' or 'verified' is older than max_age_days. Update both fields when you re-check, see docs/updating-courses.md.

items.name: MCP specification
items.notes: A new spec revision appears as a new dated folder under schema/. Re-read the changelog before changing any MCP slide.

items.name: vLLM
items.notes: Check KVTransferConfig, MultiConnector and --kv-offloading-backend in the release notes. 0.33.0 was checked against the PyPI sdist source, because the GitHub release page returned 404 on 2026-11-08; see references/research_audit_2026_11.md. Lab 5 itself was not re-run on a GPU.

items.name: Hermes Agent
items.notes: Lab 12 (1A) matches agent/memory_provider.py, agent/context_engine.py and the memory-provider and context-engine plugin docs at v0.23.0 (select_context, clone_for_agent; spawn_context_thread is in agent.memory_provider and the handout asks students to use it). v0.23.0 only added optional MemoryProvider hooks (on_profile_created, on_profile_renamed, read_config_fields, write_config_fields) and routes manual /compress to the engine's compress(force=True). Check MemoryProvider and ContextEngine in the plugin docs.
